data.title: 视频号营销
data.content: {"type":"doc","content":[{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":1},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"视频号营销"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"微信视频号营销是基于微信生态体系，以"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"bold"}],"text":"视频号相关能力在微信视频号场景内进行展示的内容营销。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"justify"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"视频号营销涵盖程序化营销与内容营销。一方面，通过整合亿万优质用户流量，利用专业数据处理算法，结合视频号内容能力与行业组件能力，为客户提供成本可控、效益可观、有效曝光的营销形式；另一方面，支持客户与视频创作者通过互选合作，达成更优质的内容营销。"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"营销形态"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"视频号营销包含丰富多元的营销形态，你可点击感兴趣的营销形态，进一步了解详情。"}]},{"type":"format","attrs":{"id":"formats_mlrAq","dataSource":[{"id":"formatItem_RkNSS","name":"视频号轮播卡片形态","description":["轮换吸睛","系列感强","多元呈现"],"media":{"type":"video","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/kob2wivu_b6c5914fdfaff8ba09e3763b938398c8.jpg","videoSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t3/b4xdzs52_1d6a87c8ac4ece923217f82f404d3def.mp4"},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=2584&pid=9197","tag":"展示“新品”标签"},{"id":"formatItem_JaoCy","name":"视频号原生短视频","description":["原生自然","内容种草","互动表态"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/cnoxphzp_ad49ee6e48c78a45a49f69c82ee51685.png","videoSrc":""},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=2584&pid=7714","tag":"不展示"},{"id":"formatItem_Xpv4_","name":"视频号原生直播","description":["实时拉取","原生呈现","便捷跳转"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/ywnf2pf4_0a57ae541f6a6d0ec76406067780a223.png","videoSrc":""},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=2584&pid=7713","tag":"不展示"},{"id":"formatItem_G9fPo","name":"视频号互选内容营销","description":["内容种草","结合创意","传播力强"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/nkokjoim_7f831ac670e8927850462187754eaf3f.png","videoSrc":""},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=2232&pid=2430","tag":"不展示"},{"id":"formatItem_ZdwAI","name":"视频号小任务","description":["覆盖面广","传播力强","全民参与"],"media":{"type":"image","imageSrc":"https://wxa.wxs.qq.com/wxadtouch/upload/t1/3ef2lz2b_8e6701047e187775bc4ec82be8836f7e.png","videoSrc":""},"link":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=2812&pid=7654","tag":"不展示"}]}},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"优秀案例"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"点击查看优秀案例文章，帮你高效投放。"}]},{"type":"caseCards","attrs":{"id":"caseCards_aJb4e","dataSource":[{"id":"caseCard_7hap6","img":"产品上线","name":"视频号直播营销升级：朋友圈引流新玩法","link":"https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/Ew-F7xH3s8M7Bo2ETLA8_g","list":["支持视频号直播营销通投至朋友圈","朋友圈两大形态支持推广直播间","丰富行业案例，助力客户高效提收"]},{"id":"caseCard_rJ4Ic","img":"案例精选","name":"2023 年微信营销七夕营销案例精选","link":"https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/O2X4Qgjg5iF14HuDge3gEQ","list":["含视频号轮播卡片营销案例","品牌色轮播卡片组件契合品牌格调","加深用户种草，提升营销转化"]},{"id":"caseCard_uP6GC","img":"案例精选","name":"视频号+朋友圈营销通投消费品行业案例","link":"https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/lSvYPAgVPuyzjO3-f8vllg","list":["多行业客户显著提升投放效果","多版位同时积累数据，加速起量","复用数据样本，成本达成更稳定"]}]}},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":2},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"相关帮助"}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":3},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"1.售卖策略"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"视频号原生营销支持曝光排期购买和曝光竞价购买两种购买方式，可根据自身诉求选择合适的购买方式；视频号互选内容营销营销费用由创作者自主决定，创作者可参考视频时长、制作成本等因素综合定价。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"link_Ru49W","src":"https://support.e.qq.com/detail?cid=4608&pid=9363","text":"详细了解售卖策略","rightIcon":"arrow-forward"}}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":3},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"2.行业准入"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"视频号营销当前已开放多个一级行业类目，符合腾讯营销准入行业要求，即可投放视频号营销。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"link_Ru49W","src":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=2085&pid=6217","text":"详细准入行业要求","rightIcon":"arrow-forward"}}]},{"type":"heading","attrs":{"level":3},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"3.人群定向"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"视频号营销支持按照地域、性别年龄、设备类型、兴趣行为定向标签、再营销等属性进行定向。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"textAlign":"left"},"content":[{"type":"link","attrs":{"id":"link_Ru49W","src":"https://e.qq.com/ads/helpcenter/detail?cid=3213&pid=9284","text":"详细了解人群定向","rightIcon":"arrow-forward"}}]}]}
